slide_title: Cell Signaling Pathway That Stimulates an Oncogene
original_text: Cell Signaling Pathway That Stimulates an Oncogene
explanation: This slide visually displays a cell signaling pathway that stimulates an oncogene. This pathway demonstrates how external growth factors and signaling cascades can lead to abnormal expression or activation of oncogenes, driving uncontrolled cell division.

questions.q: What biological pathway is represented in the diagram on this page?
opts: Cell signaling pathway that stimulates a mutated tumor suppressor gene
Cell signaling pathway that stimulates an oncogene
The pathway of chromatin remodeling via histone acetylation
The pathway of translation inhibition by microRNAs
questions.exp: Option B is correct because the slide title is 'Cell Signaling Pathway That Stimulates an Oncogene'. The other options refer to different pathways.
